recommended_first_target: Certified total TT second coordinate jets at the existing exterior apex or on a specified exterior subdomain, with a differentiated evolution error ledger.
recommended_full_domain_target: Physical-side C2 comparison to the same actual formal solution using a smoother numerical candidate and certified derivative inputs.
actual_data_regularity: Qualitative smoothness retained conditionally from the primary characteristic/trace-ODE proof; no new quantitative high-jet bounds asserted.

approximation_regularities.rational_initial_profiles: Guaranteed C1; second derivatives can jump at upper cutoff. Exact witness concerns general polynomial inputs, not every retained slot.
approximation_regularities.free_velocity: Continuous P1; slope jumps can propagate on knot characteristics.
approximation_regularities.existing_full_response: C1 certificate; cannot differentiate its error bound.

sources.supports: Candidate regularity and one-sided interpolation scope
Current order-four paired primitives and actual-versus-nominal packet distinction
Conditional actual smoothness, trace-ODE induction, differentiated same-operator recurrence and initial offsets
Actual exponential packet and current derivative oracle
C1 versus C2 lift needs and flat actual corners
Exterior total TT cone and observable limitation

quantitative_inputs_to_certify: U0_rr and V0_r, including actual-minus-candidate errors
G_x and derivative shell feedback for full-domain target
Second angular and mixed angular-coordinate operator/conversion bounds for physical curvature residuals

initial_packet_derivative_budget.higher_ODE_requirement: Inspect existing fifth derivative enclosure; a sixth derivative is not automatically required.

candidate_upgrade.packet: C5 joins, e.g. degree-eleven normalized integral of t^5(1-t)^5; exact identities and new error ledger required
candidate_upgrade.velocity: At least C1 with derivative error control
candidate_upgrade.feedback: Prove sufficient derivative continuity and derivative approximation errors
candidate_upgrade.corners: Preserve open zero collar or explicitly certify defects

region_limits: All relevant spline-knot characteristics must be audited, not just cutoff characteristics.
Existing C1 error alone does not imply local C2 error.
Physical-side C2 does not mean C2 across a distributional thin shell.
acceptance_gates: Prove representation regularity and corner compatibility
Certify declared natural residual or defined observable
weak_alternative: A declared weak/interface residual requires a specified test-function norm, derivative-jump and shell terms; it is not a pointwise C2 certificate.
